sources.title: 1.1 SAFE Act Education Requirements
sources.derivedRequirement: Annual state-licensed MLO CE has an eight-hour baseline: three Federal, two Ethics including fraud/consumer protection/fair lending, two Nontraditional, and one mortgage-origination elective. State requirements can add hours or assign the elective to state-specific instruction. Do not apply the PE category allocation to CE.
sources.reviewState: official web text read; human review pending

sources.title: 1.2 NMLS Course Approval
sources.derivedRequirement: State-required education may exceed federal hours or occupy elective hours. NMLS may coordinate approval with the relevant state agency. This general policy does not supply each agency outline, deadline, delivery exception or business-license authority.
sources.reviewState: official web text read; human review pending

sources.title: Criteria for NMLS Approved Course Provider
sources.section: Six criteria; ongoing approval; effective 2009-06-16, reviewed 2018-12-20
sources.derivedRequirement: Provider approval is a separate application decision. Criteria include lawful business/instructional infrastructure, current materials, qualifications, student feedback, completion evidence and conduct. The provider must work in good faith toward an approved course within 60 days and maintain an approved course. Source review is not permission to claim approval.

sources.expectedHeading: Policy on Criteria for Granting Approval to Become an NMLS Approved Course Provider

sources.title: Criteria for Granting NMLS Approval to a Course
sources.derivedRequirement: A course needs objectives, current sufficient unique material with usage rights, CE rigor, adequate length, an appropriate LMS/environment and defined start/end evidence. The policy defines an instructional hour as 50 minutes and requires intended-audience sampling with a median timing record for online approval. A runtime timer alone does not validate duration.

sources.title: SAFE Act's Successive Year Rule
sources.section: Purpose; Action for MLO; policy guide index dated 2026-09-04
sources.derivedRequirement: The same approved course cannot satisfy CE twice in the same year or in consecutive years. NMLS treats courses with the same content as the same course, including licensed/shared content. Review prior education records and course descriptions, not only a new local ID or grant.

sources.title: State-Specific Education Requirements (PE and CE)
sources.section: Agency links; Uniform CE Policy; SMART CE Deadline; agency table
sources.derivedRequirement: Requirements are agency-specific: the hub separately lists CA DFPI/DRE, TX OCCC/SML, UT DFI/DRE and SC BFI/DCA. Its December 5 SMART target does not replace an earlier agency deadline. Federal PE completed in the same license-approval year creates an exception in the stated Uniform CE policy. sources.title: Education FAQ - Continuing Education (CE)
sources.section: CE requirements; deadlines; Uniform CE and MU2 questions
sources.derivedRequirement: Renewal checks both federal and state CE. The FAQ distinguishes federal PE compliance from new state-specific PE, discusses license-approval timing and separately flags MU2 requirements. Eligibility cannot be inferred only from residence, enrollment or completion of a national course. Confirm individual agency exceptions before deciding eligibility.

sources.title: 1.13 End-of-Course Assessment
sources.section: 1.13.1(a)-(i); CE OSS, not heightened state-specific PE thresholds
sources.derivedRequirement: Final assessment follows other completion requirements. CE OSS minimums are 15 questions for at most two hours, 25 for at least three; bank ratio 2:1, relevant taught content, rigor, no true/false and at least 70% passing. Retakes need a high proportion of different randomized questions and anti-gaming controls. Exam time credited to course is capped at 10/20 minutes, not a maximum permitted exam duration. Exactly two attempts, 100% fresh retake items and zero final credit are provider design choices, not these numerical mandates.
sources.reviewState: official web text read; human review pending

sources.title: 1.10.3 Quizzes and Exams
sources.derivedRequirement: Tell learners the available time and passing score; permit reasonable retakes; prevent rapid wrong-answer attempts from generating credited time or an answer-mining shortcut. Online quiz/exam questions must be randomly sequenced for administrations. This section does not certify semantic independence of an authored bank.
sources.reviewState: official web text read; human review pending

sources.title: 5.2 OSS Course Design
sources.derivedRequirement: Use logical modules and instructional units; the text says single-module courses will not be approved, even for one hour. Chunk text; audio/video segments cannot exceed five minutes and need the specified supporting content/interactivity. No introductory avatar video mandate appears here. Module quizzes use at least three questions at ten minutes or less and five to ten above ten minutes, a 2:1 bank, passing before advancement and anti-gaming controls.
sources.reviewState: official web text read; human review pending

sources.title: 5.3 OSS Time Requirements
sources.derivedRequirement: Provide 50 seat minutes per approved hour, substantive unit time and linear locked-module progression. Six minutes of inactivity requires course logout without advance timeout warning and loss of affected-unit accrued time. Avoid dead time and unnaturally slow media. Annual CE cannot extend beyond December 31 for that year; reporting remains due within seven calendar days. These rules do not prove any given receipt is human attention.
sources.reviewState: official web text read; human review pending

sources.title: 5.6 OSS Identity Authentication
sources.derivedRequirement: Every OSS course requires integrated BioSig-ID authentication as a condition of NMLS approval. The public page directs providers to NMLS for the BSI interface specifications; it does not publish trusted callback details/checkpoint implementation. Account login, a synthetic fixture or an avatar is not this approval evidence.

sources.title: 1.15 Rules of Conduct for Students
sources.derivedRequirement: Each online course starts with learner reading and a click-through ROCS V4 agreement in the LMS, with agreement logs retained for five years. ROCS also belongs on the course-material cover or standalone second page. Classroom signatures are a separate format rule. No acceptance was executed here; the required V4 artifact still needs genuine-byte preservation and complete inspection.

sources.title: Reporting (Banking) of Student Credits
sources.derivedRequirement: Approved providers bank completion in NMLS within seven calendar days of course end, or individual self-paced completion. NMLS number is needed. Credit belongs to the completion calendar year; December 31 completion may be reported by January 7. An approved course applies only once per calendar year. A local certificate/pass or an unapproved free course cannot substitute for approved-course banking.

sources.title: Approved Course Data and Document Retention
sources.expectedMarker: NMLS Approved Course Data and Document Retention Policy
sources.section: Course data/document definitions; retention; Appendix 1; effective 2018-01-01
sources.derivedRequirement: Retain approved-course data/documents five years from the last date the course is taught or administered. Included evidence covers category timing, syllabus/content, gradebook/coursework/results, login/logout and attendance records, including LMS transitions. Make data available to SRR within 14 calendar days of written request. This is distinct from ROCS FAQ retention measured from course start; do not collapse the anchors into one deletion policy.

sources.title: 1.14 Course Completion Certificate
sources.expectedMarker: 1.14 Requirement for Issuance of Course Completion Certificate
sources.derivedRequirement: Approved-course completion certificates require provider name, course number/title, completion date, learner name/NMLS ID and the specified learner attestation at the end in at least the stated 10-12 point font. The provider supplies fields, not the learner. Missing survey participation cannot justify withholding certificate/banking. Preserve exact attestation from the genuine source before implementation; no certificate or learner attestation is created here.

sources.title: Marketing and Licensing of NMLS Approved Courses
sources.expectedMarker: Marketing and Licensing of NMLS Approved Courses
sources.section: Policy; Marketing Standards 1-13; licensing/trademark sections; no separate effective date shown
sources.derivedRequirement: Claims must accurately represent provider/course approval; approval wording/logo requires written active approval. The policy prohibits accredited terminology and misleading promises, requires provider/course identity in approved-course marketing and specifies provider responsibility. Licensed content needs separate receiving-provider course approval/ID; reselling/obscuring provider identity is restricted. For current free unapproved training, do not imply CE eligibility, NMLS endorsement or approval. This is not a legal clearance for operating ordinary free training in every state.
